title: My child is a late walker. Can Occupational Therapy assist in improving his mobility?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy assistance for late walkers at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network offers specialized Occupational Therapy programs to improve strength, coordination and balance, supporting walking for late walkers.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms, we understand the worry and concern about your child's mobility. Our dedicated Occupational Therapists can certainly assist your child. Using a range of strategies, they work towards enhancing your child's strength, balance, and coordination, which are key to supporting walking. Through early interventions, we aim to make considerable improvements in your child's motor skills.
